reviews.text: Very happy with their service, our kitten loves his vet!
The nurse on the front desk,very nice and treated us with respect and kindness.

Thank you so much for accommodating us with such a last-minute appointment, especially knowing that my dog was unable to walk at the time. I honestly can’t believe that just one day after taking the medication, she was back on her feet – nothing short of a medical miracle!

I’m incredibly grateful for your kindness, care and prompt help. Thank you again for getting my little one back on her paws! ❤️🐾

I am writing to express my profound disappointment and frustration following my visit to Medivet in Woolwich yesterday.
During my appointment, which was my first visit to your clinic, the veterinarian suggested an immediate blood test for Brucella for my 5-month-old puppy. This was despite my dog showing no symptoms of the condition. The primary reason for my visit was to check my dog’s microchip and ensure everything was in order, as he has recently arrived from Romania.
Unfortunately, the consultation quickly turned distressing. The doctor alarmingly suggested that if the test results were positive, my puppy would need to be euthanized, creating unnecessary panic and emotional distress. This was compounded by her lack of empathy and her attempt to scare and manipulate me into agreeing to the test.I also mentioned that my puppy had diarrhea after accidentally eating some steak from my plate. She provided me with tablets to add to his food. After leaving the clinic feeling extremely upset, I consulted with other veterinarians and friends, only to discover that the advice and actions taken by the Medivet doctor were highly questionable and manipulative.Given that I paid £200 for this visit, which I find unacceptable given the circumstances, I am requesting a full refund. I have already sought legal advice regarding this matter and am determined to address what I perceive as unethical behaviour from the veterinarian.I expect immediate action to rectify this situation.
